seoTitle: How to Integrate Google Sheets and ClickUp (2026)
metaDescription: Link ClickUp with Google Sheets to build an automated task tracking dashboard, syncing statuses and rows between your board and spreadsheet.
intro: Manually keeping a Google Sheets tracker aligned with your ClickUp board means duplicate work and outdated data. By installing the integration from the Workspace Marketplace, you can automate task creation and status syncing between the two tools. This guide covers the full connection and automation setup.

steps.heading: Install the integration app
steps.body: Access the ClickUp integration from the Workspace Marketplace and install it for your spreadsheet.

steps.heading: Connect your ClickUp account
steps.body: Grant workspace permissions and authorize your personal or team ClickUp account to link with your spreadsheet.

steps.heading: Map columns to task fields
steps.body: Match your spreadsheet columns to the corresponding ClickUp task fields, including custom fields.

steps.heading: Set up automation triggers
steps.body: Configure triggers so new spreadsheet rows automatically create ClickUp tasks.

steps.heading: Sync statuses and assignees
steps.body: Enable syncing so status changes and assignee updates flow back into your Google Sheet.

steps.heading: Test the live sync
steps.body: Create a sample row and confirm a ClickUp task is generated correctly, then check that the sync runs on the schedule you set.

faq.question: Will new spreadsheet rows automatically become ClickUp tasks?
faq.answer: Yes, once automation triggers are configured, new rows can automatically create corresponding tasks in ClickUp.

faq.question: Can I sync ClickUp status changes back to my spreadsheet?
faq.answer: Yes, the integration supports syncing status changes and assignee updates back into Google Sheets.

faq.question: Do I need admin access to install the integration?
faq.answer: You'll need permission to install apps from the Workspace Marketplace and to authorize your ClickUp account connection.

faq.question: Can I map custom ClickUp fields to my spreadsheet columns?
faq.answer: Yes, custom fields and assignee metrics can be mapped directly to specific spreadsheet columns during setup.
